title: MailEnable parseObjectResponse XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-114552)
description: CVE-2026-114552 is an XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability in MailEnable's parseObjectResponse method. It allows authenticated remote attackers to disclose sensitive information due to improper restriction of XML external entity references. The vulnerability impacts confidentiality but does not affect integrity or availability. No patch information is currently available.
